passives.name: Hubris
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Damage taken increases proportional to the number of debuffs inflicted on Dahlia. Fixed damage other than Skill Chains and damage from Dark enemies does not exceed 1000, and Cursed damage does not exceed 10000. Does not receive Weakness Gauge damage and greatly reduces damage taken from enemies with 100 or more Chain Points. Completely reduces Effectiveness of non-Light/Earth enemies and Critical Hit Chance of Defender, Striker, and Healer enemies.
